svg.text: Agentic SOC platform - component architecture (tools, modules, technologies, endpoints)

Production shape in the client's environment. Boxes are real components (file / module / technology / table / vendor endpoint). R = read, W = write (policy-gated). Orange = the only path that can change a security tool.
Agentic SOC platform (Python 3.11) - Docker images, non-root uid 1001
dead one taken over in 120 s
no pip in the runtime image
Request pipeline - api/app.py (every request, in this order)
core/ - shared services (services take a Session and never commit; the request or job owns the transaction)
base.py: BaseConnector, TokenBucket (thread-safe rate budget), with_backoff (Retry-After <= 120 s), SyncRunner
(sync, sync_many: parallel download, ordered ingest, savepoint + commit per page), Page, Watermark, LookupResult
http.py: HttpTransport (httpx), FixtureTransport (fake mode), OAuth2ClientCredentials, RFC 7523 certificate
assertion (x5t, 10 min), BasicAuth, ApiKeyHeader/Query, RoutingTransport (Graph + ARM), raise_for_status
registry.py: MANIFEST discovery, ConnectorRegistry (isolation, stages fake/record/read/recommend/automate)
config_schema.py (strict, did-you-mean) | preflight.py (sign-in, streams, scopes) | conform.py (shape from fixtures)
recording.py (record-and-sanitise) | devkit.py (connector new / check) | tools/*.py: one module per tool (21)
Outbound only through each connector's TokenBucket; 401 -> token renewed once, 403 -> PermissionDenied
Context: entities, entity_keys, entity_hints, relations, source_records, unresolved_items, resolution_overrides
Cases: cases, evidence, case_entities, case_notes, decisions, dispositions
Actions and governance: action_requests, policy_versions, connector_config_versions, access grants, api keys
Audit and logs: audit_log (hash chain), access_log, llm_calls / usage, job_runs, system_flags (leases, kill switch)
Phishing: ph_submissions (unique source_ref) | Vulnerability: vm_findings, campaigns, action plans,
vuln_exceptions, risk register, vuln_intel | Intelligence: insights, briefs | notifications | blobs (stored files)
Flows (numbered badges) - each explained step by step in the component architecture document
Sign-in: browser -> proxy/WAF -> soc-api; Entra token (RS256, JWKS) -> roles + domain scope.
Collect: scheduler job -> SyncRunner.sync_many -> connector fetch_page -> normalize -> context_store.ingest.
Request: BodyLimit -> Security -> current_user -> need(Perm, domain) -> handler -> commit -> headers.
Investigate: workflow -> EnrichmentOrchestrator (parallel lookups) -> evidence -> fixed-rule scoring.
Phishing: reported mail -> decompose -> rules + offline ML -> campaign / clicks / impact -> case.
Correlate and report: RiskEngine -> 13 rules -> insights -> notify / reports (python-docx / pptx).
Act: recommendation -> PolicyEngine.decide -> approval (four-eyes) -> ActionService -> connector write.
Explain: LLMGateway -> Redactor -> client LLM -> citation + figure checks -> narrative stored.
Every step: trace id (observability.py), audit_log append, access_log row, JSON log to SIEM.
21 connectors (tools/*.py) - vendor APIs over HTTPS 443, one least-privilege identity per tool
W revoke sessions, disable, reset, risk
API key exchanged for a token
field map; bad item refused alone
